This is the story of a German pharmaceutical company, a billion-dollar opioid business, and a crisis spanning multiple continents. 
Is a new opioid crisis looming — one made in Germany?

This video is based on research by “The Examination,” a nonprofit newsroom investigating preventable health risks. Many thanks to the team for their support behind the scenes.

Read the full article here:
https://www.theexamination.org/articl...

You can find Tanja Albroscheit’s petition here:
https://www.change.org/p/dr-klaus-rei...

Many thanks as well to Maria Christoph from Paper Trail Media. Her in-depth article for the German magazine Spiegel is available here:
https://www.spiegel.de/panorama/gesel...

To better understand the situation in West Africa, make sure to watch this ARTE documentary: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8r3E_-O44io
title: Exposing a $1,900,000,000 Pharma Company
